The '''Livet Tower''' was a small tower on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] and connected to the city's [[Theed Funeral Temple/Legends|Funeral Temple]] by a bridge that spanned the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]]. It housed an [[Eternal Flame]], which was intended as a reminder to the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] of their mortality and an admonition for them to live in harmony.<ref name="Star Wars: Complete Locations 2005">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>

==History==
[[File:Funeral_Temple.png|thumb|left|250px|The Livet Tower at the time of [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn's]] [[Funeral of Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|funeral]]]]
Constructed on the outskirts of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], the Livet Tower was a quiet, reflective place sought out while mourning the dead. An unadorned tower of stone, the tower contained the [[Eternal Flame]] which served to remind the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] of the transience of their current life and their duty to lead harmonious lives.<ref name="IWSWE">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Episode I]]''</ref>

It was Naboo belief that a body must be cremated within two days of death in order to return the life force of the dead to the planet. The ashes were then thrown from the bridge between the [[Theed Funeral Temple/Legends|Funeral Temple]] and the Livet Tower, and into the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]] before its plunge over the cliff.<ref name="IWSWE" />
